title: Silicite Tools and Armor
description: Silicite is a rare earth minerals found in the deepest of the world, about the area where diamonds are found. Strong, and Durable.
body:
Silicite is an extremely rare earth mineral found at diamond level. With a strength stronger then netherite, it is extremely strong for end game usage.


# Future Change Ideas!

Gold Varient (Nether - New BLOCK TYPE, Armor calms piglins)
Dragon Varient (End - Requires Dragon Breath Bottles 4x)
